program:
procedure DentalCleaningReminders {
  about "Remind each patient about their cleaning"
  policy DentalPolicy
  sheet Patients "Patients" { name: Text, mobile: Phone, next_visit: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, medical_history: Text private }
  trigger every day at 08:00

  let all = fetch Patients
  let due = filter all where date_of(next_visit) == today() + 1 day
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 100 sms to r.mobile: "Hi {r.name}, a reminder from the office: your cleaning is tomorrow at {time_of(r.next_visit)}."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 1 day else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}
